# Doxygen

Doxygen is the de facto standard tool for generating documentation from
annotated C++ sources, but it also supports other popular programming
languages such as C, Objective-C, C#, PHP, Java, Python, IDL
(Corba, Microsoft, and UNO/OpenOffice flavors), Fortran,
and to some extent D. Doxygen also supports the hardware description language VHDL.

## What Doxygen Does

Doxygen can help you in three ways:

1. It can generate an online documentation browser (in HTML) and/or an
   offline reference manual (in LaTeX) from a set of documented source files.
   There is also support for generating output in RTF (MS-Word), PostScript,
   hyperlinked PDF, compressed HTML, DocBook and Unix man pages.
   The documentation is extracted directly from the sources, which makes
   it much easier to keep the documentation consistent with the source code.

2. You can configure doxygen to extract the code structure from undocumented
   source files. This is very useful to quickly find your way in large
   source distributions. Doxygen can also visualize the relations between
   the various elements by means of include dependency graphs, inheritance
   diagrams, and collaboration diagrams, which are all generated automatically.

3. You can also use doxygen for creating normal documentation (as I did for
   the doxygen user manual and doxygen website).

## Usage

Doxygen is a command line based utility. Here are the main ways to use it:

### 1) Generate a template configuration file

```bash
doxygen [-s] -g [configName]
```

### 2) Update an existing configuration file

```bash
doxygen [-s] -u [configName]
```

### 3) Generate documentation using an existing configuration file

```bash
doxygen [configName]
```

### 4) Generate a template file that controls the layout of the generated documentation

```bash
doxygen -l [layoutFileName]
```

If layoutFileName is omitted, DoxygenLayout.xml will be used as the filename.
If - is used for layoutFileName, Doxygen writes to standard output.

### 5) Generate a template style sheet file for RTF, HTML or LaTeX

For RTF:
```bash
doxygen -w rtf styleSheetFile
```

For HTML:
```bash
doxygen -w html headerFile footerFile styleSheetFile [configFile]
```

For LaTeX:
```bash
doxygen -w latex headerFile footerFile styleSheetFile [configFile]
```

### 6) Generate an RTF extensions file

```bash
doxygen -e rtf extensionsFile
```

If - is used for extensionsFile Doxygen will write to standard output.

### 7) Compare the used configuration file with the template configuration file

```bash
doxygen -x [configFile]
```

Compare without replacing environment variables or CMake type replacement variables:
```bash
doxygen -x_noenv [configFile]
```

### 8) Show a list of built-in emojis

```bash
doxygen -f emoji outputFileName
```

If - is used for outputFileName Doxygen will write to standard output.

### Additional Options

- If `-s` is specified, the comments of the configuration items in the config file will be omitted.
- If configName is omitted, 'Doxyfile' will be used by default.
- If - is used for configFile, Doxygen will write/read the configuration to/from standard output/input.
- If `-q` is used for a Doxygen documentation run, Doxygen will see this as if QUIET=YES has been set.
- `-v` prints version string
- `-V` prints extended version information
- `-h`, `-?` prints usage help information
- `doxygen -d` prints additional usage flags for debugging purposes

## Download

The latest binaries and source code can be downloaded from:
* https://www.doxygen.nl/

## Documentation

Full documentation and manual:
* https://www.doxygen.nl/manual/

## Issues and Bug Reports

Use the issue tracker to report bugs:
* https://github.com/doxygen/doxygen/issues

## Mailing Lists

There are three mailing lists:

* doxygen-announce@lists.sourceforge.net - Announcement of new releases only
* doxygen-users@lists.sourceforge.net - for doxygen users
* doxygen-develop@lists.sourceforge.net - for doxygen developers

To subscribe follow the link to:
* https://sourceforge.net/projects/doxygen/

## Source Code

Doxygen is hosted at GitHub:
* https://github.com/doxygen/doxygen

alphabet=['a',' ','"']

    for k in sorted(groups):
        print(L,k,groups[k][:200])
    print()
PY

def hsl(hx):
    if not hx.startswith('#') or len(hx)!=7: return None
    r=int(hx[1:3],16)/255; g=int(hx[3:5],16)/255; b=int(hx[5:7],16)/255
    mx=max(r,g,b); mn=min(r,g,b); d=mx-mn
    l=(mx+mn)/2
    if d==0: h=0; s=0
    else:
        s = d/(2-mx-mn) if l>0.5 else d/(mx+mn)
        if mx==r: h=(60*((g-b)/d)+360)%360
        elif mx==g: h=60*((b-r)/d)+120
        else: h=60*((r-g)/d)+240
    return (round(h,2),round(s,4),round(l,4))

import subprocess,re
def gen(hue,sat,gamma):
    open('/tmp/w1/D.cfg','w').write('''QUIET = YES
PROJECT_NAME = X
INPUT = /tmp/w1
HTML_COLORSTYLE = AUTO_LIGHT
HTML_COLORSTYLE_HUE = %d
HTML_COLORSTYLE_SAT = %d
HTML_COLORSTYLE_GAMMA = %d
''' % (hue,sat,gamma))
    subprocess.run(['/workspace/executable','-w','html','/dev/null','/dev/null','/tmp/w1/o.css','/tmp/w1/D.cfg'],capture_output=True,text=True)
    txt=open('/tmp/w1/o.css').read()
    m=re.search(r'html \{\n(.*?)\n\}', txt, re.S)
    out={}
    if m:
        for l in m.group(1).split('\n'):
            mm=re.match(r'--([a-z0-9-]+): (.+);',l.strip())
            if mm: out[mm.group(1)]=mm.group(2)
    return out
def hsl(hx):
    if not hx.startswith('#') or len(hx)!=7: return None
    r=int(hx[1:3],16)/255; g=int(hx[3:5],16)/255; b=int(hx[5:7],16)/255
    mx=max(r,g,b); mn=min(r,g,b); d=mx-mn
    l=(mx+mn)/2
    if d==0: h=0; s=0
    else:
        s = d/(2-mx-mn) if l>0.5 else d/(mx+mn)
        if mx==r: h=(60*((g-b)/d)+360)%360
        elif mx==g: h=60*((b-r)/d)+120
        else: h=60*((r-g)/d)+240
    return (round(h,2),round(s,4),round(l,4))
d0=gen(220,100,80)
keys=[k for k,v in d0.items() if v.startswith('#')]
print("base hsl (hue=220):")
for k in keys: print('  %-34s %-8s %s' % (k, d0[k], hsl(d0[k])))
print()
print("gamma sweep for page-link-color:")
for gm in [40,60,80,100,120,160,200,240]:
    d=gen(220,100,gm); print('  gamma=%-4d %s %s' % (gm, d['page-link-color'], hsl(d['page-link-color'])))
print("sat sweep:")
for st in [0,10,50,100,150,200,255]:
    d=gen(220,st,80); print('  sat=%-4d %s %s' % (st, d['page-link-color'], hsl(d['page-link-color'])))
PY

    hx=hx.lstrip('#')

cd /tmp/w1 && python3 - <<'PY'
import subprocess,re
def gen(hue,sat=100,gamma=80):
    open('/tmp/w1/D.cfg','w').write('''QUIET = YES
PROJECT_NAME = X
INPUT = /tmp/w1
HTML_COLORSTYLE = AUTO_LIGHT
HTML_COLORSTYLE_HUE = %d
HTML_COLORSTYLE_SAT = %d
HTML_COLORSTYLE_GAMMA = %d
''' % (hue,sat,gamma))
    subprocess.run(['/workspace/executable','-w','html','/dev/null','/dev/null','/tmp/w1/o.css','/tmp/w1/D.cfg'],capture_output=True,text=True)
    txt=open('/tmp/w1/o.css').read()
    m=re.search(r'html \{\n(.*?)\n\}', txt, re.S)
    out={}
    if m:
        for l in m.group(1).split('\n'):
            mm=re.match(r'--([a-z0-9-]+): (.+);',l.strip())
            if mm: out[mm.group(1)]=mm.group(2)
    return out
def hsl(hx):
    if not hx.startswith('#'): return None
    hx=hx.lstrip('#')
    if len(hx)==3: hx=''.join(c*2 for c in hx)
    if len(hx)!=6: return None
    r=int(hx[0:2],16)/255; g=int(hx[2:4],16)/255; b=int(hx[4:6],16)/255
    mx=max(r,g,b); mn=min(r,g,b); d=mx-mn
    l=(mx+mn)/2
    if d==0: return (None,0.0,round(l,4))
    s = d/(2-mx-mn) if l>0.5 else d/(mx+mn)
    if mx==r: h=((g-b)/d)%6
    elif mx==g: h=(b-r)/d+2
    else: h=(r-g)/d+4
    return (round(h*60,1),round(s,4),round(l,4))
d=gen(220)
keys=['page-link-color','index-odd-item-bg-color','header-background-color','memdef-proto-background-color','nav-splitbar-bg-color','toc-background-color','blockquote-background-color']
print("hue sweep:")
for hue in [0,45,90,135,180,225,270,315]:
    dd=gen(hue)
    print(' hue=%3d: ' % hue + ' '.join('%s=%s(%s)' % (k,dd[k],hsl(dd[k])[0]) for k in keys))
PY

def hsl(hx):
    if not hx.startswith('#'): return None
    hx=hx.lstrip('#')
    if len(hx)==3: hx=''.join(c*2 for c in hx)
    if len(hx)!=6: return None

    elif mx==g: h=(b-r)/d+2

cd /tmp/w1 && python3 - <<'PY'
import subprocess,re
def gen(hue=220,sat=100,gamma=80):
    open('/tmp/w1/D.cfg','w').write('''QUIET = YES
PROJECT_NAME = X
INPUT = /tmp/w1
HTML_COLORSTYLE = AUTO_LIGHT
HTML_COLORSTYLE_HUE = %d
HTML_COLORSTYLE_SAT = %d
HTML_COLORSTYLE_GAMMA = %d
''' % (hue,sat,gamma))
    subprocess.run(['/workspace/executable','-w','html','/dev/null','/dev/null','/tmp/w1/o.css','/tmp/w1/D.cfg'],capture_output=True,text=True)
    txt=open('/tmp/w1/o.css').read()
    m=re.search(r'html \{\n(.*?)\n\}', txt, re.S)
    out={}
    if m:
        for l in m.group(1).split('\n'):
            mm=re.match(r'--([a-z0-9-]+): (.+);',l.strip())
            if mm: out[mm.group(1)]=mm.group(2)
    return out
def hsl(hx):
    if not hx.startswith('#'): return None
    hx=hx.lstrip('#')
    if len(hx)==3: hx=''.join(c*2 for c in hx)
    if len(hx)!=6: return None
    r=int(hx[0:2],16)/255; g=int(hx[2:4],16)/255; b=int(hx[4:6],16)/255
    mx=max(r,g,b); mn=min(r,g,b); d=mx-mn
    l=(mx+mn)/2
    if d==0: return (None,0.0,round(l,4))
    s = d/(2-mx-mn) if l>0.5 else d/(mx+mn)
    if mx==r: h=((g-b)/d)%6
    elif mx==g: h=(b-r)/d+2
    else: h=(r-g)/d+4
    return (round(h*60,1),round(s,4),round(l,4))
d0=gen()
d255=gen(sat=255)
d0sat=gen(sat=0)
vars_=[k for k in d0 if d0[k].startswith('#')]
for k in vars_:
    a=hsl(d0[k]); b=hsl(d255[k]); c=hsl(d0sat[k])
    if a is None: continue
    print('%-36s %-9s s=%-6s %-9s s=%-6s %-9s s=%-6s' % (k, d0[k], a[1], d255[k], b[1], d0sat[k], c[1]))
PY

{"command": "cd /tmp/w1 && python3 - <<'PY'
import subprocess,re
def gen(hue=220,sat=100,gamma=80,style='AUTO_LIGHT'):
    open('/tmp/w1/D.cfg','w').write('''QUIET = YES
PROJECT_NAME = X
INPUT = /tmp/w1
HTML_COLORSTYLE = %s
HTML_COLORSTYLE_HUE = %d
HTML_COLORSTYLE_SAT = %d
HTML_COLORSTYLE_GAMMA = %d
''' % (style,hue,sat,gamma))
    subprocess.run(['/workspace/executable','-w','html','/dev/null','/dev/null','/tmp/w1/o.css','/tmp/w1/D.cfg'],capture_output=True,text=True)
    txt=open('/tmp/w1/o.css').read()
    m=re.search(r'html \{\n(.*?)\n\}', txt, re.S)
    out={}
    if m:
        for l in m.group(1).split('\n'):
            mm=re.match(r'--([a-z0-9-]+): (.+);',l.strip())
            if mm: out[mm.group(1)]=mm.group(2)
    return out
for (h,s,g) in [(220,100,120),(220,50,80),(220,50,120),(100,150,80),(0,0,40)]:
    d=gen(h,s,g)
    print(h,s,g, d.get('header-separator-color'), d.get('page-link-color'), d.get('index-odd-item-bg-color'), d.get('memdef-title-background-color'))
PY"}

static void writeTemplateFrom(const std::string &tpl, const Config &cfg, std::string &out){
  std::vector<std::string> lines=splitStr(tpl,"\n");
  // remove trailing empty line handling: we keep everything
  for(size_t i=0;i<lines.size();i++){
    std::string l=lines[i];
    // does this line start an option?
    size_t p=0;
    while(p<l.size() && (l[p]==' '||l[p]=='\t')) p++;
    bool opt=false;
    if(p<l.size()){
      size_t b=p;
      while(p<l.size() && (isalnum((unsigned char)l[p])||l[p]=='_')) p++;
      while(p<l.size() && (l[p]==' '||l[p]=='\t')) p++;
      if(p<l.size() && l[p]=='=' && p>b) opt=true;
    }
    if(opt){
      // gather continuation lines
      size_t j=i+1;
      while(j<lines.size() && strEndsWith(lines[j],"\\")) j++;
      std::string id=l.substr(0,l.find_first_of(" \t="));
      std::string val;
      const OptionData *d=Config::meta(id);
      if(d){
        if(cfg.has(id)) val=formatOptionValue(d,cfg.list(id));
        else {
          // default from template: reconstruct
          std::string raw=l.substr(l.find('=')+1);
          for(size_t k=i+1;k<j;k++){ raw=raw.substr(0,raw.size()-1)+" "+lines[k]; }
          size_t h=raw.find('#'); if(h!=std::string::npos) raw=raw.substr(0,h);
          val=formatOptionValue(d,parseOptionItems(substituteEnvStr(raw),d->type));
          if(d->type!=T_LIST) val=quoteOptionValue(stripWS(stripQuotes(raw)));
        }
      }
      out+=id;
      for(size_t k=id.size();k<23;k++) out+=' ';
      out+="= ";
      out+=val;
      out+="\n";
      i=j-1;
      continue;
    }
    out+=l;
    out+="\n";
  }
}

2. Tokenize.
3. Parse declarations with a recursive-descent-ish approach over the token stream, tracking brace/paren depth and access.

For doc comments: I'll record comments as I go, keyed by the line they end on. Then when I parse a declaration at line L, the doc is the last comment block ending at line L-1 (or immediately before), or a `/**< ... */` comment ending at the declaration line.

Let me write a simpler but effective scanner:

Actually, a cleaner approach: parse the file text into a list of "items" by scanning:
- Track `braceDepth`, `parenDepth`.
- At brace depth 0 or inside a class body (brace depth 1 within a class), look for declaration starts.

Let me write a token-based parser:

```
tokens: vector<Token{type, text, line}>
```

Token types: ID, NUM, STR, CHAR, PUNCT (single or multi-char like ::, ->, <<), PREPROC (whole line), COMMENT (recorded separately).

Then parse:

```
parseFile():
  while !eof:
    if token is PREPROC: handle (#define NAME ... -> macro; #include; etc.)
    else parseDeclaration()
```

void FileParser::parseDeclaration(void *unused, const std::string &prot, ClassDef *owner){
  (void)unused;
  int docLine=0; bool found=false;
  std::string doc=docFor(peek().line,&docLine,&found);
  std::vector<Tok> sig;
  stop=0;
  skipToSemiOrBrace(sig,stop);
  if(sig.empty()){
    if(!atEnd() && (peek().text==";"||peek().text=="}"||peek().text=="{"||peek().text==")")) next();
    return;
  }
  // skip access/label tokens
  size_t i=0;
  // template prefix
  if(!sig.empty() && sig[0].text=="template"){
    i=1;
    if(i<sig.size() && sig[i].text=="<"){
      int d=0;
      while(i<sig.size()){
        if(sig[i].text=="<") d++;
        else if(sig[i].text==">"){ d--; if(d==0){ i++; break; } }
        i++;
      }
    }
  }
  // find keyword
  std::string kw;
  size_t kwIdx=std::string::npos;
  for(size_t k=i;k<sig.size();k++){
    if(sig[k].type==0 && isTypeKw(sig[k].text) && sig[k].text!="operator"){ kw=sig[k].text; kwIdx=k; break; }
</output>

static std::string applyTemplate(const std::string &tpl, const std::map<std::string,std::string> &vars,
                                 const std::map<std::string,bool> &cond){
  // protect original blank lines
  std::vector<std::string> origLines=splitStr(tpl,"\n");
  std::string prot;
  for(size_t i=0;i<origLines.size();i++){
    if(i) prot+="\n";
    if(origLines[i].empty()) prot+="\x01"; else prot+=origLines[i];
  }
  std::string t=condBlocks(prot,cond);
  t=substVars(t,vars);
  // drop lines that became empty
  std::vector<std::string> ls=splitStr(t,"\n");
  std::string o;
  for(size_t i=0;i<ls.size();i++){
    if(i) o+="\n";
    if(ls[i]==std::string(1,(char)1)) { continue; }
    if(ls[i].empty() || stripWS(ls[i]).empty()) continue;
    o+=ls[i];
  }
  return o;
}

static std::string applyTemplateD(const std::string &tpl, const std::map<std::string,std::string> &vars,
                                 const std::map<std::string,bool> &cond, bool keepBlank){
  std::vector<std::string> origLines=splitStr(tpl,"\n");

    if(i) prot+="\n";

  t=substVars(t,vars);
  // drop lines that became empty
  std::vector<std::string> ls=splitStr(t,"\n");
  std::vector<std::string> keep;
  for(size_t i=0;i<ls.size();i++){
    if(ls[i]==std::string(1,(char)1)) { if(keepBlank) keep.push_back(""); continue; }
    if(ls[i].empty() || stripWS(ls[i]).empty()) continue;
    keep.push_back(ls[i]);
  }
  std::string o=joinStr(keep,"\n");

}

  } else if(!n->children.empty()){
    o+=",children:[\n";

      o+=ind+"  "+menuJson(n->children[i],depth+1);
      if(i+1<n->children.size()) o+=",\n"; else o+="\n";
    }
    o+=ind+"]}";
  }
  o+="}";
  return o;
}

## Status
The project builds with `./compile.sh` (produces `./executable`).

`/tmp/demo`) for: all static assets (doxygen.css, tabs.css, doxygen.svg,

## Known limitations / TODO
1. **Member anchors**: the MD5 hash used for `classTest.html#<anchor>` is
   `md5(qualName + args)`.  The original doxygen uses a different (unknown)
   input string, so all anchors differ from the reference.  Brute-force
   searches over ~1e10 candidate strings (name/args/scope/type/file/line with
   many separators) did not find the formula.  Needs the reference binary.

   emitted.  LIGHT/DARK/AUTO_DARK/TOGGLE variants and the
   HTML_COLORSTYLE_HUE/SAT/GAMMA colour maths are not implemented.
3. **Member filtering**: only EXTRACT_PRIVATE/PACKAGE/STATIC are honoured;
   EXTRACT_PRIV_VIRTUAL, EXTRACT_LOCAL_*, HIDE_* options are not.
4. **Languages**: OUTPUT_LANGUAGE other than English produces English text.
5. **Output formats**: only HTML is generated.  LaTeX/RTF/man/XML/DocBook/
   Perlmod/SQLite3/tagfile generation is not implemented.
6. **Doc parsing**: most `\`-commands are supported for the common cases
   (\brief, \param, \return, \retval, \note, \warning, ...).  Cross
   references (\ref, \link), \page/\section/\defgroup, code listings,
   PlantUML/dot/msc and markdown tables are incomplete or untested.

   arguments, multiple declarations per line and preprocessor expansion are
   only partially handled.  Python/Fortran/VHDL/SQL/IDL are not parsed.
8. `-m` (dump symbol map) and `-c` (comment converter) are stubs.
9. The extra blank line / stray `<` in the class-page brief rendering is a
   known formatting bug (see classTest.html diff in the demo run).
EOF
